verdict.rationale: Trello documents a first-party REST API whose user token 'can be used to read and write for your entire Trello account', with Batch, Search and Webhooks resources and an MCP server. That is broad programmatic access, but nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates parity with the UI. Failed OpenAPI probes at guessed paths do not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement, documentation that UI features (e.g., automation, templates, card mirroring, merge) are API-accessible, a published machine-readable spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
